publicationStmt.p: For anyone, anywhere, but made specifically for the Research Commons Workshop.

div.head: Introduction
div.p: Thank you for attending this TEI Workshop! This editor is a small sandbox for playing around with TEI. The left hand side contains a TEI text editor and the right hand side is the rendered version of the TEI XML encoding.In most cases, someone working on TEI should use a dedicated XML Editor, like oXygen XML.

div.head: Instructions
div.p:
The buttons above all load in different TEI documents from a variety of projects:
Basic
This document Malcolm X (Digital Editions Journal)
An edition of Alex Haley's The Malcolm X. I Knew, edited by Amy E. Earhart et al for Scholarly Editing (vol. 35). Metropolis Coronota (MoEML)
A diplomatic transcription of Anthony Munday's Lord Mayor Show Metropolis Coronota, edited by Janelle Jenstad et al. for The Map of Early Modern London. Commentary on Miss Nume
A transcription of Winnifred Eaton (Onoto Watanna)'s commentary on her novel Miss Nume of Japan, edited by Mary Chapman et al for The Winnifred Eaton Archive (forthcoming) Learning the TEI
The journal article Learning the TEI in a Digital Environment by Stella Dee, encoded in TEI itself for the Journal of the Text Encoding Initiative (JTEI), iss. 7.
Use the buttons above to view both the original TEI source and their rendered versions.
The TEI source on the left is editable; edit and press the View button to see how the changes to the TEI source affect the final product.
